name: The Songstress
summary: One of the six Wayward Haints of the Ghostlight Express.

stages.journal: A smoking singer at the window of the Lounge Car, humming the same eight bars. She wants one last song for someone who truly listens.
stages.hint: The window seat of the Lounge Car. Talk to them, or ask the Vagrant through a grille.

stages.journal: We carried her the phonograph from the Sleeper Car. She sang her last verse, and the Lord and Lady danced.
We listened until she sang it.
We corked her in a jar, mid-hum.

stages.hint: Fight it, or leave the car; it will not follow.

stages.journal: We put her down. The window is only a window now.
